maya: Perf CI failed on PR 9345 — microbench batch_latency jumped ~12% on main -> please triage. CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/2259876543
perf-bot: [perf-ci] microbench/batcher_latency: baseline=1.20ms new=1.35ms delta=+12.5% threshold=+5% status=FAIL commit=4cb2f7a job=linux-gpu-pt1
jon: running the microbench locally now, will try to reproduce with --kernel=autoselect and --kernel=legacy
liam: fyi i bisected to commit 4cb2f7a (the kernel selector PR). The change drops weight of fused-attn kernel for seq_len>256 which could explain latency bump
sarah: i grabbed the CI perf trace — KV cache miss rate spikes during multi-request scenario, see snippet:
```
kv_cache: hits=120 miss=38 evictions=6 hit_rate=76% -> hit_rate=62% (post-change)
batch_scheduler: avg_batch_wait=2.3ms -> 3.1ms
```
oliver: can we repro with a simple script? maya, can you paste the bench command you used in CI?
maya: CI uses: `tools/bench/run_microbench --test batcher_latency --seq-len 512 --parallel 8 --kernel autoselect`
liam: okay that aligns. autoselect chose a different kernel for the attention path which is slightly cheaper per-token but increases batch assembly time + interacts poorly with kv cache warmup
jon: i'll run a matrix: seq_len 128/256/512, parallel 4/8, compare autoselect vs legacy. should have results in ~30m
maya: perf flamegraph (CI trace) posted to #perf-artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/ff/2259876543/flame.html — you can see spikes at batcher wait and torched kernel launch
liam: proposal: revert kernel-selector heuristic in 4cb2f7a as a rollback until we adjust cost model + kv warmup heuristics. This is rollout-blocker for Dedicated release.
maya: opened revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/9372 — flagged as revert and added bisect notes
jon: started local runs, early numbers show autoselect +512 = +13% vs legacy, +128 negligible. kv miss amplification seems seq_len-dependent
sarah: added CI trace + kv stats to the issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/2114 — includes perf logs and repro script
perf-bot: Re-run queued: job=linux-gpu-pt1 rerun-id=2259876799
oliver: tagging eng-sre for capacity/infra check in case noise from noisy hosts: @eng-sre
maya: marking PR 9345 as hold and adding "rollback-blocker" label. We'll run post-revert CI and follow-up with cost-model tuning
liam: i'll work on cost model patch and kv warmup tune, will link experimental results here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
